title: RubbleFront: a turn-based tactics roguelite built with Claude Code (free demo + 100 free alpha keys)
author: PurplelinkPL
selftext:
Growing up, I loved Advance Wars on the GBA and nintendo DS. But they stopped making them and I missed the style. So I made RubbleFront, a turn-based tactics game where you fight a war and grow your veterans (similar to XCOM style).

Free demo for Mac and Windows

The Claude Code workflow:

•	⁠Godot 4, all of it in GDScript written through Claude Code. I describe the change, Claude makes it in a git worktree, the full test suite runs twice, then it merges. Nothing goes in on one green run.  
•	⁠Tests. About 75k lines of them, against 110k lines of game code. A bot plays whole runs to prove a run can be finished. Balance studies play the same seeds on every difficulty.  
•	⁠Screenshots. A tool opens every screen in a scripted state at iPhone and desktop sizes and saves a picture. Before and after a UI change I diff the two sets, then have a second model review the pictures, in English and German.  
•	⁠Optimization. One hot spot at a time, a before and after measurement, proof the output is identical, then merge. 23 of those so far.  
•	⁠Art is ChatGPT image generation, cut and cleaned by Python scripts Claude wrote. Audio is generated by code.

I also have 100 free keys for the full alpha and all future updates. Reply to this comment if you want one and I'll DM you a key, first 100.

The alpha is currently $4.99 on itch, with every update. I plan to give alpha owners a Steam key when it comes to Steam in Spring 2027: https://rubblefront.itch.io/rubblefront

Happy to answer anything about the setup.
